mode: dry: generate with style references; wet: edit dry counterpart

samples.name: terrain-dry-bed-left
samples.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Style references: Kenney tile sheets. Produce exactly ONE square terrain tile, no sprite sheet. 16×16 terrain tile: left end of a raised bed of dry light-brown ploughed soil with horizontal furrows, rounded left edge, grass path above and below. Tiles seamlessly with the middle piece on its right. Cozy medieval Slavic village farming game. Strict 16x16 logical pixel grid enlarged: every pixel is a large flat square, no subpixel detail. Top-down, no isometric perspective. Opaque tile with sage-green grass top three and bottom three logical pixel rows. Soil band occupies middle ten rows. Three simple continuous horizontal furrows at matching heights. Light warm brown dry soil. Soil rounded only at left end, reaches right canvas edge. Maximum 3 flat soil colors and 2 grass colors. No gradients, noise, shading textures, plants, labels, outlines around canvas, objects, shadows, transparent gaps or extra panels.
